events.title: Drift, In and Out: Art Exhibit by Linsey Gray
events.description: In the heat of the summer, time seems to lose its rigid edges, softening into the hazy, rhythmic expanse of a daydream. *Drift, In and Out*, invites you to step into this liminal space—a place where the rush of the day-to-day fades, replaced by the slow, restorative cadence of the natural world. Opening Reception August 12th from 4pm – 6pm Join artist Linsey Gray for conversation and light hors d’oeuvres provided by Table Asheville 18 N. events.title: Hot Shop: 30 Minute Make Your Own
events.description: Receive a guided experience to create your own glass keepsakes in our glassblowing studio. In this hands-on class, you will work one-on-one with an experienced instructor to create a unique piece of glass art. Choose between crafting a paperweight, ornament, pumpkin, or cup, then customize your piece with your choice of two colors. Learn the basics of glassblowing, and feel free to ask questions as your instructor assists you during the entire process! All levels welcome. If you would like to [trimmed]

events.title: Champagne + Shopping
events.description: Unwind. Sip. Adorn. Join us every Friday and Saturday from 5 to 7pm for our signature in-store ritual. Champagne + Shopping is a moment to pause, to play, and to discover. Whether you’re exploring fine jewelry, finding your new must-have handbag, or trying on a new fragrance, you’ll be surrounded by warmth, beauty, and bubbles. No appointment needed. Just bring your sparkle.

events.title: Life Drawing 2nd Tuesdays – Medium Poses, Undraped
events.description: Untutored sessions with live model, undraped. All mediums allowed. Please use non-odor solvents if using oil mediums. The short/medium sessions will begin with ten 1-minute short poses for a quick warm-up, then 10, 15, and 20-minute poses for the remainder of the 2 hr. session. Pre-registration is requested. You may register on site IF there is space available. Adult attendees only. Doors close at 5:50 to allow for prompt start at 6pm.

events.title: Third Thursday Open Studio Social
events.description: Third Thursdays are opportunities for artists to network, share ideas, and create together with extended gallery hours! Feel free to bring supplies and work on art among community. Resident artists and outside artists are all welcome. Event happens 5 pm-close, time depending on turn out

events.title: Mars Landing Gallery – First Fridays in Mars Hill, NC
events.description: The Catherine Cervas Fine Art Gallery is open for First Fridays! All are welcome to visit Mars Landing Arts Center, Mars Hill, NC, where you will find her showing in Gallery #2. About 20 minutes north of Asheville, Mars Hill offers First Friday events from 5:00pm-8:00pm. It is a great place to see more art to kick off your weekend in Western North Carolina! For more information, visit catherinecervasfineart.com
